items.title: Russell Brand's ex Jemima Goldsmith accuses him of violence and abuse against her
items.summary: Goldsmith accuses the disgraced entertainer of "violence, coercive control and abuse" while the two were together.

items.title: What happened inside court as Brand was sentenced
items.summary: The BBC's Sima Kotecha was inside the court as the judge sentenced Brand to 10 years and six months in prison, after being convicted of rape and sexual assault.

items.title: Hundreds more offenders to leave jail on Tuesday
items.summary: At least 1,350 offenders have been released from jail early under the scheme so far.

items.title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England
items.summary: The government says it is strengthening its guidance for schools in England, which came into force in June.

items.title: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'
items.summary: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation in the Middle East change.

items.title: The superpower battle over energy – and what it means for your bills
items.summary: A tug-of-war between China and the US could have a big impact on energy costs, but who will win?

items.title: 'Baffling but brilliant' post-apocalyptic novel The End of Everything wins Booker Prize
items.summary: M John Harrison becomes the oldest ever winner of the prestigious literary award at the age of 81.

items.title: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor
items.summary: A woman says an agency boss sent her to photoshoots at the sex offender's Florida beach home.
